title: AI-03 forbidden-word list (evaluation/forbidden-words.json)
description: The versioned list of verdict, score, ranking and approval words the chat's answers must never contain (AGENTS rule 4, decision 0004, WCHAT-67 to 80). A word matches whole words only, case-insensitively, so 'Safestore' and 'safety' do not match 'safe'. The list is not applied inside the places named in allowIn, and the phrases in allowPhrases are masked first.

allowPhrases.description: Whole phrases masked before matching, because they are a source's own name for a metric (for example the DfT 'connectivity score'). Each phrase's source is cited in sources.
